title: Azmi and the Borrowed Faces
logline: Azmi wears a hundred masks until Nour asks to see the one beneath.
story: A hundred faces hung by the door, and Azmi, for all of spirited resolve, wore a different one for every visitor. Then Nour, who was light (the city's intrinsic light), asked a single quiet question: which face do you wear when no one is watching? Azmi had no answer, and that silence was more frightening than any crowd. So Azmi began, slowly, to set the masks down one by one, and found beneath them not emptiness but a plain, unguarded face. It was the only face anyone had ever truly wanted to meet.
moral: The self you hide in order to be loved is the very self that love was looking for.
